supersedes_reason: The prior rank-0 campaign (TRIGGER_ONLY/BOUNDED_TRIGGER_ONLY) is gated on an EXTERNAL trigger (NEW_OBSERVED_LIQUIDATION_SOURCE) that cannot fire within this closed research environment on frozen data. That trigger gating is itself the structural bottleneck: future agents would idle waiting for a signal that the frozen panel cannot produce. This campaign removes that bottleneck by executing a heavy, non-deferrable evidence-consolidation and quantitative meta-analysis campaign NOW on the verified frozen panels and the already-complete terminal artifact record, so that significant progress continues without an external trigger.

two_scientific_halves: (a) Funding rate conditions volatility (realized-volatility, RV) — terminal on frozen FCLR-001 panel
(b) Funding rate conditions liquidation risk — terminal on frozen combined liquidation panel
mandate.reconciliation: Both halves are reconciled by funding conditioning. This campaign consolidates every terminal verdict with exact statistics, performs a pre-registered quantitative effect-size meta-analysis across the terminal campaigns, preserves the negative results with mechanistic explanations, audits frontier exhaustion per domain, and emits a forward decision framework.

design.data_source: existing terminal research_state/session_* artifacts + frozen panels (no new outcome generation)

meta_analysis_protocol.effect_size_metric: standardized funding-conditioning effect = mean_diff / mean_abs_outcome (per test), aggregated across terminal campaigns
meta_analysis_protocol.aggregation: inverse-variance weighted fixed-effect synthesis over the terminal funding-conditioning contrasts, with a random-effects (DerSimonian-Laird) sensitivity check
meta_analysis_protocol.regime_stratification: separate synthesis for (a) RV outcome and (b) liquidation-intensity outcome, plus a joint cross-pillar synthesis
meta_analysis_protocol.verdict_rule: synthesis verdict is DESCRIPTIVE/CONSOLIDATORY only; it does NOT promote any terminal hypothesis. It states whether the consolidated evidence across terminal campaigns is directionally coherent, and it carries forward the honest terminal verdicts unchanged.

non_avoidance: This campaign is heavy and non-deferrable: it requires a quantitative meta-analysis script that reads both frozen panels, aggregates exact effect sizes across >=7 terminal campaigns, runs a fixed-effect + random-effects synthesis with heterogeneity statistics, and produces an independent stdlib recompute. Prose-only, trigger-check-only, or placeholder artifacts do NOT satisfy the gate. Re-running any terminal campaign (STARTER-001 / XSEC-001..008) does NOT satisfy this task.
